channel.title: Fire Engineering Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Fire Engineering Magazine (fireengineering.com)

item.title: MA Firefighters Battle Two-Alarm Fire Amid Freezing Conditions
item.description: A two-alarm fire at a home on Otis St. in Lowell caused significant damage but no injuries. Firefighters faced challenges from cold weather and snow while battling the fire.

item.title: Fire Chiefs Fault Local Leadership as US Senate Probes Palisades (CA) Fire
item.description: Emergency response leaders testified that failures in local leadership, not firefighters, led to the Palisades fire's devastation, highlighting issues in preparedness and command oversight.

item.title: One Dead as Early-Morning Fire Strikes Brooklyn (NY) Apartment Building
item.description: A fire in a Brooklyn apartment building early Thursday resulted in one death and displaced a resident.

item.title: Triaging a Lost Bail Anchor
item.description: No amount of preparation or technology can account for a lost anchor. Alex Degnan on immediate options for the best chance at an effective bail.

item.title: A Closeup Look at Large-Scale Fires
item.description: Host Eric Dreiman welcomes guest Anthony Avillo for a discussion about the challenges of large-scale fires that expand past the initial response.

item.title: Eastern KY School Destroyed in ‘Devastating’ Fire, Officials Say
item.description: A fire destroyed Dessie Scott School in Wolfe County, with no injuries reported. Officials are planning to support students and rebuild, emphasizing the school's importance to the community.

item.title: At Least Two Reported Dead in IL House Explosion
item.description: At least two people died in a house explosion in Oswego, IL, on Thursday. The cause of the explosion is under investigation, and firefighters conducted searches for victims.

item.title: Drawn by Fire: Tough Tackle
item.description: If modern fire service leaders fail to evolve to meet the demands of the fireground, they put firefighters at unnecessary risk.

item.title: Three Firefighters, Two Civilians Taken to Hospitals After Pair of Devastating Fires in NY
item.description: Two three-alarm fires in Staten Island sent five people to hospitals. One fire caused a partial building collapse, while the other is under investigation. Both resulted in significant damage.

item.title: Three Horses and Other Animals Die in Barn Fire at a CT Farm
item.description: A barn fire at Fox Field Farm in Branford resulted in the deaths of three horses and other animals. Firefighters faced extreme conditions but prevented the fire from spreading further.
